# Pictiq

> Pictiq is an open visual language for short, composable messages across language barriers.

Pictiq uses framed canonical SVG tiles, composition, context packs, numeric notation, and a separate Entity Symbols registry. It is a project in active development, not a replacement for natural language or an empirically proven universal language.

## Primary resources

- Site: https://pictiq.abvx.xyz/
- Pictiq mode: https://pictiq.abvx.xyz/?mode=pictiq
- Composer: https://pictiq.abvx.xyz/composer/
- Lexicon: https://pictiq.abvx.xyz/lexicon/
- Source and specifications: https://github.com/markoblogo/pictiq
- Handbook: https://github.com/markoblogo/pictiq/tree/main/books/handbook-v1

## Project facts

- 87 ordinary canonical icons and 16 separate Entity Symbols.
- Canonical SVG assets use a stable fitting standard and currentColor-compatible artwork.
- Pictiq Message Format v0.1 and Pictiq Shorthand v0.1 provide structured message interchange.
- The browser Composer creates and exports short visual messages from canonical project assets.

## Scope and limitations

- Context may resolve intentionally broad symbols; Pictiq preserves distinctions required for a decision, not every source-language distinction.
- Research findings, experiments, and deferred hypotheses are documented in the repository and should not be treated as settled evidence.
- Source assets and documentation are licensed under CC BY-NC 4.0; commercial use requires a separate agreement.
